title: 第4章 我后悔了第5章 出城
slug: 天道酬勤开局联姻落魄千金
lines: “请进。”
在将一名客人迎入李府之后，洛秋华拂起袖子将额间细汗拭去，她搀扶着身形略微有些佝偻的丈夫，看了一眼身后并不算热闹的李府，感叹道：“真是没想到，如今我李家这般处境，沈家竟还愿意联姻。”
李彦君五官十分俊朗，即使特意收拾过一番，可那眉梢里的憔悴依旧藏不住。
他捂着小腹，咳嗽一声，道：“是啊，想我们当年风光无限时，李家门庭若市，如今遭遇变故，却只有沈家没有选择落井下石，坚持联姻。”
李彦君的语气中带着些许欣慰。
当年两家联姻后，李家刚成为这东城区的少数几大中等家族，还未彻底站稳脚跟之时，沈家的聘礼给过很大帮助。
这些恩情，他一直记在心中，虽然事后没少扶持过沈家，甚至那沈长瑞如今能拜入名师之下也有他李家的功劳，但此前，李彦君依旧有些担心沈家会悔婚。
毕竟，如今的李家，除非将赖以生存的老底拿出去，否则根本还不了聘礼。
同时，他也盼望着两家联姻之后，沈家能做出帮扶。
“就是苦了颜儿。”
想到自己那本该风华正茂，却被他们连累的女儿，洛秋华便一脸痛心：“也不求沈家能帮衬我们多少，只希望颜儿嫁过去之后，能给予她资源、用心培养，只要她能成功踏入化丹境，一切便都还有希望。”
修行离不开资源，尤其是在这灰雾区内，而如今的李家，莫说是给李沐颜提供修行资源，就是一些窟窿都需要他们的女儿来帮忙添补，这种情况下，想要修行有成谈何容易？
李彦君握住她的手，安慰道：“放心吧，颜儿是什么人我们还不知道吗，她有自力更生的能力，况且资质也不差，只要她能不被我们影响，安心修炼，化丹境是迟早的事。”
在两人交谈间，一阵清脆的马蹄声已行至近前。
李彦君与洛秋华同时抬头看向前方，见对方身着一袭大红喜袍，正以为是沈家沈长瑞前来接亲了，可再一看来人的面容，却是一张二人都没见过的脸。
李彦君不由低语一声：“没想到这漓江北畔今日还有别家结姻，真巧啊。”
“是啊。”
洛秋华点点头，看着前方越来越近的一人一马，小声嘀咕道：“不过这阵仗也太寒酸了些，怎么只有新郎一人来接亲，哪家女儿要是嫁给他，怕是有些倒霉了哟。”
他已来到近前，听到了两人的谈话声。
正是这时，方鸿突然从马匹后面走了出来，他嘴角带着一丝笑意，对着李彦君两人便是朗声道：“新郎到！”
见到方鸿，李彦君与洛秋华皆是一愣，两人心中不由的生出了一丝不好的预感。
果不其然，下一刻，就见方鸿快步走上前去，递过聘书，微笑道：“李家主、洛夫人，姑爷已到，还不快快迎进门。”
李彦君二人一时懵在原地，从方鸿的话中，他们得知了两个重要的消息，原来面前这陌生男子就是他们的女婿，而且还是上门女婿！
在洛秋华下意识接过聘书后，李彦君终于反应了过来，他沉着脸，皱眉问道：“方管事，你是不是搞错什么了？”
两家的联姻不应该是李沐颜嫁到沈家，现在怎么突然变成上门做婿了，而且这联姻对象也变了人？
一旁的沈长青并不做声，神情也很平静，眼前这一幕，他已有预料。
“李家主，联姻一事干系重大，我沈家绝无半分弄虚作假。”
方鸿义正辞严道：“两家联姻聘书中写的是由李家长女与沈家长子联姻，而你们眼前这位姑爷，正是我沈家的长子沈长青。”
李彦君与洛秋华更懵了，他们怎么不知道沈家还有个名叫沈长青的长子？
“大少爷他从小遗失在外，最近才寻回来。”
方鸿笑着解释道：“不过二位放心，大少爷他除了修行资质平庸一些，就没有其他缺点了。”
此刻，听到对方的话，再感受到沈长青身上养气境后期的气息，李彦君哪里还不明白事情的来龙去脉，他阴沉着脸，压抑着滔天怒意，“好，好一个沈家！”
洛秋华也明白了过来，她怒视着方鸿，恨不得将手中的聘书重重砸在对方脸上，“你们沈家当真是欺人太甚！”
两人皆是聪明人，自然能看得出来，这天赋平庸的长子沈长青遗失在外多年，却偏偏在李家出事后才被寻回来替弟联姻，沈家这般作为，对李家来说，无疑是比直接悔婚还要令人作呕！
“两位说笑了。”
方鸿面不改色，道：“我沈家不过只是如约而行罢了，况且我家大少爷虽然平庸，但毕竟是上门做婿，你们并不吃亏，又何来欺人？”
李彦君自知如今他李家若是悔婚，不仅要归还聘礼，而且更是会变成理亏的一方，一时也是被气的无法反驳，只得看向一旁被当做牺牲品的沈长青，冷哼道：“倒是没想到你沈家能如此狠心！”
方管事摇头一笑，道：“家主大人的决定，在下不敢妄议，只是，李家主莫非是想用最后一座药庄和丹方来赔礼？”
自黑雾降临后，修行所需的灵药受到了大幅影响，如今培育灵药的药庄，皆是建立在城外山川精华汇聚之地。
此外，药庄培育出来的灵药还需要依靠一些特殊的炼制方法处理后才能使用，而这些方法，往往被归纳为丹方，它们也是临江府大部分家族的发家之本。
例如李家，就曾掌握着这五座药庄与数门丹方，只是如今，皆是只剩下了其一。
李彦君冷冷注视着方鸿，换做以前，若是对方敢这么与他说话，此刻定然已经跪在了地上，但如今，他在沉默了许久之后，才开口道：“此事，我们需要征求颜儿的意见。”
content_en:
"Please come in."
After welcoming a guest into the Li Mansion, Luo Qiuhua rolled up her sleeves and wiped away the sweat on her forehead. She supported her slightly stooped husband, glanced at the not-so-busy Li Mansion behind her, and sighed: "I never expected that the Shen family would still be willing to marry in the current situation of my Li family."
Li Yanjun's facial features were very handsome, and even though he had specially cleaned them up, the haggardness in his eyebrows could not be hidden.
He held his belly, coughed, and said, "Yes, I think back when we were very prosperous, the Li family was a prosperous family. Now that things have changed, only the Shen family did not choose to add insult to injury and insist on marriage."
Li Yanjun's tone was filled with relief.
After the marriage between the two families, the Li family had just become one of the few large and medium-sized families in Dongcheng District. Before they could fully establish themselves, the betrothal gift from the Shen family had been a great help.
He has always kept these kindnesses in his heart. Although he has supported the Shen family a lot afterwards, and even the fact that Shen Changrui is now a famous teacher is due to his Li family, before that, Li Yanjun was still a little worried that the Shen family would regret their marriage.
After all, today's Li family cannot pay back the betrothal gift unless they take out the money they depend on for survival.
At the same time, he also hopes that after the marriage between the two families, the Shen family can help.
"It's just painful for Yan'er."
Luo Qiuhua looked sad when he thought of his daughter who should have been in her prime but was implicated by them: "I don't ask the Shen family to help us much. I just hope that after Yan'er gets married, they can give her resources and train her carefully. As long as she can successfully enter the realm of alchemy, there will be hope for everything."
Cultivation is inseparable from resources, especially in this gray fog area, and now the Li family, not to mention providing cultivation resources to Li Muyan, even needs their daughter to help fill some holes. Under such circumstances, how easy is it to succeed in cultivation?
Li Yanjun held her hand and comforted her: "Don't worry, we don't know who Yan'er is yet. She has the ability to be self-reliant, and her qualifications are not bad. As long as she can not be affected by us and practice with peace of mind, it will be a matter of time before she reaches the elixir realm."
While the two were talking, a crisp sound of horse hooves approached.
Li Yanjun and Luo Qiuhua looked up at the same time and saw the other person wearing a bright red wedding robe. They thought it was Shen Changrui of the Shen family who came to pick up the bride, but when they looked at the person's face again, it turned out to be a face that neither of them had seen before.
Li Yanjun couldn't help but whisper: "I didn't expect that there would be another marriage on the north bank of the Lijiang River today. What a coincidence."
"Yeah."
Luo Qiuhua nodded, looked at the people and horses getting closer and closer in front of him, and murmured in a low voice: "But this battle is too shabby. Why is it that only the groom comes to pick up the bride? If any daughter marries him, she will be unlucky."
Shen Changqing: "..."
He had come closer and heard the conversation between the two.
At this moment, Fang Hong suddenly walked out from behind the horse. With a smile on his lips, he said loudly to Li Yanjun and the other two: "The groom is here!"
Seeing Fang Hong, Li Yanjun and Luo Qiuhua were both stunned, and they couldn't help but have a bad feeling in their hearts.
Sure enough, the next moment, Fang Hong walked forward quickly, handed over the letter of appointment, and said with a smile: "Master Li, Mrs. Luo, my uncle has arrived, why don't you come in quickly."
Li Yanjun and Li Yanjun were stunned for a moment. From Fang Hong's words, they learned two important pieces of news. It turned out that the strange man in front of them was their son-in-law, and he was also a door-to-door son-in-law!
After Luo Qiuhua subconsciously accepted the appointment letter, Li Yanjun finally reacted. He frowned and asked with a sullen face, "Manager Fang, did you make a mistake?"
The marriage between the two families shouldn't have been about Li Muyan marrying into the Shen family. Why did she suddenly become the son-in-law? And the marriage partner also changed?
Shen Changqing on the side remained silent and looked very calm. He had already anticipated the scene before him.
"Master Li, the marriage is of great importance, and our Shen family will never commit any fraud."
Fang Hongyi said sternly: "The marriage contract between the two families states that the daughter of the Li family will marry the son of the Shen family, and the uncle in front of you is none other than Shen Changqing, the eldest son of the Shen family."
Li Yanjun and Luo Qiuhua were even more confused. Why didn't they know that the Shen family had an eldest son named Shen Changqing?
"The eldest young master has been lost since he was a child and was only found recently."
Fang Hong smiled and explained: "But don't worry, the eldest young master has no other shortcomings except for his mediocre cultivation qualifications."
At this moment, after hearing the other party's words and feeling the aura of Shen Changqing's late-stage Qi-nourishing realm, Li Yanjun still didn't understand the whole story. He had a gloomy face and suppressed his overwhelming anger, "Okay, what a Shen family!"
Luo Qiuhua also understood. She glared at Fang Hong and wanted to smash the letter of engagement in his face, "You Shen family are really bullying others!"
Both of them are smart people, and they can naturally see that the eldest son Shen Changqing, who is mediocre in talent, has been missing for many years, but he was found only after something happened to the Li family to marry his younger brother. What the Shen family did is undoubtedly more disgusting to the Li family than directly regretting the marriage!
"You two were joking."
Fang Hong's face didn't change and he said: "My Shen family is just keeping the promise. Besides, although my eldest son is mediocre, he is here to be his son-in-law after all. You don't suffer any loss, so how can you bully others?"
Li Yanjun knew that if the Li family regretted their marriage now, not only would they have to return the betrothal gift, but they would also become the party in the wrong. He was so angry that he could not refute. He could only look at Shen Changqing who was being treated as a victim and snorted coldly: "I didn't expect that your Shen family could be so cruel!"
Manager Fang shook his head and smiled, and said: "I don't dare to discuss the decision of the family master. However, could it be that the Li family master wants to use the last medicine store and the elixir to make amends?"
Since the arrival of the black fog, the elixirs needed for practice have been greatly affected. Nowadays, the medicine shops that cultivate elixirs are built in places where the essence of mountains and rivers gather outside the city.
In addition, the elixirs cultivated by the medicine store also need to rely on some special refining methods before they can be used, and these methods are often summarized as elixirs. They are also the foundation of most families in Linjiang Prefecture.
For example, the Li family once controlled these five medicine shops and several elixir recipes, but now, only one of them is left.
Li Yanjun stared at Fang Hong coldly. In the past, if the other party dared to talk to him like this, he would have been kneeling on the ground at this moment. But now, after being silent for a long time, he said: "We need to seek Yan'er's opinion on this matter."
